text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm making my way home with Mejiro
Dober after
checking out the stores
around the station when...

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Dad? Can we stop by the shrine
festival on
the way home? Pleeease?

text_block_list.name: Girl's Father
text_block_list.text:
All right, but we're only staying for a
little while.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Huh. I didn't know there was a festival
today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What?! N-no... I never said I wanted to!
choice_data_list: 気になるなら行ってみようか？

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
No, it's all right. I just didn't know it was

happening.
choice_data_list: じゃあ俺につき合ってほしい
じゃあ私につき合ってほしい

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What? B-but...
choice_data_list: じゃあ俺につき合ってほしい
じゃあ私につき合ってほしい

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What? B-but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Geez. You're so pushy...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Fine. But just for a bit.
Berry? Is that you?
Berry? Is that you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: D-Dad?! What are you doing here?!

text_block_list.name: Dober's Father
text_block_list.text:
I'm here on a business trip. I was just on
my way to
see you, Berry!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ugh! I'm not a child anymore, so stop
calling me
that!

text_block_list.name: Dober's Father
text_block_list.text:
Haha, of course. A child couldn't be
working so
hard at Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Dober's Father
text_block_list.text:
You must be her trainer. Thank you for
always
taking care of my daughter. I've
heard so much
about you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I-it's not like I talk about you all the
time! I just
keep him updated on how
things are going.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Well... I can't really tell him about how
things are
going without mentioning you.

text_block_list.name: Dober's Father
text_block_list.text:
Dober says she really appreciates all you
do for
her. Keep up the good work!

text_block_list.name: Dober's Father
text_block_list.text:
Dober says she really appreciates all you
do for
her. Keep up the good work!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: H-hey! Cut it out already!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Stop being such a busybody, Dad! I can
thank her
myself.

text_block_list.name: Dober's Father
text_block_list.text:
A festival, eh? Brings back memories... I

remember taking you to one when you
were little.

text_block_list.name: Dober's Father
text_block_list.text:
A festival, eh? Brings back memories... I

remember taking you to one when you
were little.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...That was ages ago.

text_block_list.name: Dober's Father
text_block_list.text:
At the very end of the festival, they sent
up the
fireworks, and you reacted in the
sweetest way.

text_block_list.name: Young Dober
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Look at all the shooting stars! I
have to
hurry and make a wish before
they're gone!

text_block_list.name: Dober's Father
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Those aren't shooting stars,
honey. They're
called fireworks.

text_block_list.name: Young Dober
text_block_list.text:
What?! No way, they're definitely
shooting stars!
They're gonna make my
wish come true!

text_block_list.name: Young Dober
text_block_list.text:
Star light, star bright, I wish to become a
big,
strong racer who can win any race!

text_block_list.name: Dober's Father
text_block_list.text: That's how I remember it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
What's with that look on your face?
Wipe it off
this second!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
D-don't laugh at me! I know the
difference
between them now.

text_block_list.name: Dober's Father
text_block_list.text:
Haha. I'm just glad you're doing well.
Ever since
you started competing, I've
been worried you've
been pushing
yourself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Dober's Father
text_block_list.text:
Haha. I'm just glad you're doing well.
Ever since
you started competing, I've
been worried you've
been pushing
yourself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Dober's Father
text_block_list.text:
Well, I wish I could stay longer, but I
have to get
going. I'll see you later,
Berry.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Dad! How many times do I have to tell
you to
stop... Ugh, never mind. Bye,
Dad.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Sigh. I thought I'd grown after I started competing seriously...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
But if I'm still making him worry, it must
mean I
have a long way to go.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm not! This has nothing to do with you
anyway!
choice_data_list: そう気を落とさないで

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I know... But it still bothers me.

お父さんはドーベルを認めてくれているよ

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Even harder...
choice_data_list: もっと活躍して立派なところを見せよう
お父さんはドーベルを認めてくれているよ

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Even harder...
choice_data_list: 不安がなくなるくらい、たくさん！

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I don't need you giving me a pep talk!
I'm going
to win all my races and make a
name for myself!
choice_data_list: 不安がなくなるくらい、たくさん！

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. Instead of sitting around
and being
sad about it, I need to do
something.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...And I'm going to do it by growing
faster,
stronger.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to grow faster and
stronger—strong
enough to hold my
head up high for my dad!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober's determination gleams
brilliantly in
her intense gaze.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober's determination gleams
brilliantly in
her intense gaze.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh? And how would you know that?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...How can you know? You're not him.

娘を大事にしているのが伝わってきたから

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...To him, I'm still his little girl. He's
always been
overprotective, always
worried sick over every
little—
choice_data_list: 娘を大事にしているのが伝わってきたから
娘を大事にしているのが伝わってきたから

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Then you get how I feel, right? It
hurts
because I know how much he loves
me. I don't
want to make him worried all
the time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Sigh. Maybe if I grow stronger, he'll see I can stand on my own.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That's why I need to grow faster and

stronger—strong enough to hold my
head up high
for my dad!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though she acts annoyed at her father,
her drive
to grow as a racer is sincere
and firm.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober's determination gleams
brilliantly in
her intense gaze.
